# Your first show

1. Choose **Add files** or **Add folder**, or drop local media on the window.
2. Double-click a running-order item to prepare it in **Preview**. Preview audio is muted.
3. Select **Program A** or **Program B** as the Take destination.
4. Press **TAKE** or **Ctrl+Enter**. The current Program stays until the incoming media provides its first frame.
5. Open **Outputs**, select a Program and a display, then choose **Open output**. Assign the same Program twice to mirror it; choose another Program for independent content.
6. Press **Escape** on an output window to close it. Closing an output does not stop its Program.
7. Choose **Save show** to write a .mizinshow project. Media originals are never modified or deleted.

## Language and decoding

English is the default. Choose Português (Brasil) in the top bar. This changes interface labels while playback continues; filenames stay unchanged. Settings offers automatic hardware selection or CPU decoding, applied after restart. Actual codec and hardware support depend on the backend, drivers and media.

## Prototype limits

This build implements local native playback, cuts, paused Preview, two independent Programs and mirrored video frames. Dissolves, scheduling, remote control and production performance qualification are future milestones. Layout-preview mode uses generated example content and does not play real media.
